body:
### Summary

Building spaCy 3.8.16 from source on CPython 3.15.0 (Windows x64) compiles and imports fine, but **any `spacy.load()` of a model crashes** during tokenizer deserialization:

```
File "spacy/tokenizer.pyx", line 787, in spacy.tokenizer.Tokenizer.from_disk
File "spacy/tokenizer.pyx", line 833, in spacy.tokenizer.Tokenizer.from_bytes
  self.rules = {}
File "spacy/tokenizer.pyx", line 128, in spacy.tokenizer.Tokenizer.rules.__set__
  self._flush_specials()
File "spacy/tokenizer.pyx", line 239, in spacy.tokenizer.Tokenizer._flush_specials
  del self._specials[k]
OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to C ssize_t
```

Since there are no cp315 wheels yet, building from source is currently the only way to try spaCy on 3.15 — and this is where it lands.

### A/B test (controlled, same build recipe both sides)

| | CPython 3.14.2 | CPython 3.15.0 |
|---|---|---|
| spaCy 3.8.16 built from source, `--no-build-isolation`, Cython 3.0.12 | **works** (`spacy.load('en_core_web_sm')` → NER ok) | **crashes** (traceback above) |
| dependency stack | preshed 3.0.13, cymem 2.0.13, murmurhash 1.0.15, blis 1.3.3, thinc 8.3.13 | identical versions, all built from source on 3.15 |
| official wheels | work (production) | n/a — none published for cp315 |

On the 3.14 side I built the wheel (`pip wheel spacy==3.8.16 --no-build-isolation`), unzipped it to an isolated dir and loaded it via `PYTHONPATH` so the official site-packages install was untouched — the source-built copy loads models fine. Same commands on 3.15 crash. With the build recipe and dependency stack held identical, the remaining variable is the Python version itself.

### Steps to reproduce (Windows x64, Python 3.15.0)

Toolchain: VS Build Tools 2022 (MSVC 14.44), Windows SDK 10.0.26100, LLVM (clang — blis's build looks for it), BLIS_ARCH=generic (clang rejects `-mavx512pf` in the skx kernels).

```
py -3.15 -m pip install cython numpy setuptools wheel
py -3.15 -m pip install murmurhash==1.0.15 cymem==2.0.13 preshed==3.0.13 --ignore-requires-python --no-build-isolation
# blis needs BLIS_ARCH=generic with clang on this box:
BLIS_ARCH=generic py -3.15 -m pip install blis==1.3.3 --ignore-requires-python --no-build-isolation
py -3.15 -m pip install thinc==8.3.13 --ignore-requires-python --no-build-isolation
py -3.15 -m pip install spacy==3.8.16 --ignore-requires-python --no-build-isolation
py -3.15 -m pip install https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/download/en_core_web_sm-3.8.0/en_core_web_sm-3.8.0-py3-none-any.whl
py -3.15 -c "import spacy; spacy.load('en_core_web_sm')"   # → OverflowError
```

### Notes

- I could not honor the `cython>=0.25,<3.0` build pin: NumPy 2.x's `__init__.pxd` hard-errors on Cython < 3.0 ("the NumPy Cython headers require Cython 3.0.0 or newer"), so on 3.15 Cython 3.x is forced. Tested both Cython 3.0.12 and 3.3.0 — identical crash; and the 3.14 side of the A/B also used Cython 3.0.12 (i.e. violating the pin the same way) and works, so the Cython version alone doesn't explain it.
- Dependency skew ruled out: an earlier run had preshed 3.0.10 on the 3.15 side; after upgrading to 3.0.13 (matching the working 3.14 stack) the crash is unchanged.
- The value that fails conversion is a key coming out of `for k in self._specials` (PreshMap iteration) in `_flush_specials`; on 3.15 the int→C conversion in the generated code raises where 3.14 doesn't. I'm not claiming a specific CPython change — just reporting the controlled difference.

### Environment

- spaCy 3.8.16 (source), thinc 8.3.13, preshed 3.0.13, blis 1.3.3, cymem 2.0.13, murmurhash 1.0.15, Cython 3.0.12, numpy 2.5.3
- CPython 3.15.0 / 3.14.2, Windows 10 x64 (26200), MSVC 14.44.35207 + LLVM
- env: `BLIS_ARCH=generic`

Happy to run any further experiment you'd want on this box (it has the full source-build toolchain set up).

comments.body:
I could not reproduce this with the 3.15 wheel, and I think the crash tracks preshed rather than the interpreter or the build route.

Linux x86_64, CPython 3.15.2, spaCy 3.8.18 from the cp315 wheel, `en_core_web_sm` 3.8.0: it crashes with preshed 3.0.13 (no cp315 wheel, so it is compiled from sdist) and loads normally with preshed 3.0.15. That is consistent with #14058, where 3.0.14 fails and 3.0.15 fixes it on 3.13 and 3.14, so this looks like the same preshed bug rather than a 3.15 deserialization change.

title: Python 3.15 (source build): `OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to C ssize_t` in `Tokenizer._flush_specials` on any `spacy.load()` — same recipe works on 3.14
